dimensions.assessment: Affects the internal administration and location of incorporation for the National Woman's Relief Corps organization.
dimensions.evidence: moves the National Woman's Relief Corps' place of incorporation and domicile from the District of Columbia to Illinois

dimensions.assessment: Administrative relocation of an organization's headquarters and designated agent details.
dimensions.evidence: moves its principal office in Illinois from Springfield to Murphysboro
